request.user:
Subject: Botany
Question type: single-correct (exactly one option is right)

(NEET 2019) Which of the following is the green expanded part ofleaf with vein and veinlets?
(A) Petiole
(B) Node
(C) Stipule
(D) Lamina

result.working: The leaf has three parts: leaf base, petiole and lamina. The lamina (leaf blade) is the green, expanded part of the leaf. It carries the veins and veinlets. The petiole is the stalk, the node is the point of attachment on the stem, and stipules are small leaf-like outgrowths at the leaf base. So the answer is Lamina.
